name: computer_use__zoom
description:
Capture a cropped JPEG of a window region (x1,y1)–(x2,y2) in screenshot pixel coordinates, with 20% padding added on each side. The output image is at most 500 px wide.

After a zoom, pass `from_zoom=true` to click/type_text to auto-translate coordinates back to full-window space.

pid.description: Target pid — required for from_zoom click/type translation.

x1.description: Left edge of region in screenshot pixels.

x2.description: Right edge of region in screenshot pixels.

y1.description: Top edge of region in screenshot pixels.

y2.description: Bottom edge of region in screenshot pixels.
